author: GamingBolt
description:
Generally speaking, Duskfade is a fantastic game with a fun story full of mature themes and a likeable pair of protagonists in Zirian and Cuckoo. 

While its combat might feel simple and shallow, the gameplay doesn’t feel out of place for what the game is trying to be at its core – an approachable 3D action platformer that can be enjoyed by just about any member of the family.
title: Duskfade Review - A Wonderful Throwback to PS2-Era Platformers

author: GamingBolt
description:
Whatever your thoughts may be on Marvel's Wolverine, whether it's exhaustion at Insomniac still handling superhero titles or excitement at finally embodying arguably the most well-known anti-hero in comic books, it's clear that this isn't just corridor crawl. 

There's real depth to Logan's story, and it goes beyond simply opening up more spaces or having things to collect. For being the best he is at what he does, I want everything that goes into his most memorable stories – even the not-so-nice parts.

Credit: Some footage was used from: Punish/BlueThunderReal.
title: Marvel’s Wolverine - Why Are Some GAMERS Hating It? (And Why It Doesn't Make Sense)

author: GamingBolt
description:
Mortal Shell 2 is beginning to gain some serious traction as more players try out the new and improved take on Fallgrim it brings to the table. The Foundling makes way for the Harbinger, and it's a shift that extends beyond your playable protagonist. Everything’s different this time around, in ways that make us think fondly of a Soulslike title that shook things up enough to remain a unique addition to the genre.

We’re talking, of course, about Bloodborne, a title that we believe has a lot in common with Mortal Shell 2. We’re sure you’re curious why, which is why we’re asking you to join us on a trek through Yharnam and Fallgrim that shows both places have many similarities despite their differences. 

This is an interesting one, and a nostalgic look at a classic, so jump right in!
title: Mortal Shell 2 Could Be The Bloodborne 2 We Never Got
